import { A, Navigate, Outlet, useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from "@shadow-js/router";

export function Shell() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { id } = useParams();

  return (
    <div>
      <nav>
        <A to="/" class="brand" preload="intent">
          Home
        </A>
        <A to="/posts" end activeClass="current">
          Posts
        </A>
        <a href="/about">About</a>
      </nav>
      <button onClick={() => navigate("/posts/new", { replace: true })}>New</button>
      <p>
        {location.pathname} {id}
      </p>
      {id === undefined ? <Navigate to="/posts" replace /> : <Outlet />}
    </div>
  );
}
